question: What accomplishment and scope of application does this ritual procedure secure?
premises: The prescribed procedure directs a specific ritual act of invocation.
The intended outcome of that act is supreme accomplishment.
This same procedure applies universally to all liṅgas.
inference: By following this procedure, one secures supreme accomplishment in all liṅgas.
plain_english: One should invoke the supreme accomplishment; this procedure applies to all liṅgas.
